# Vendored: fibre-pack

This directory is a vendored copy of **fibre-pack** by Vedrana Andersen Dahl, included for
reproducibility of the simulation study in this repository.

- Upstream: https://github.com/vedranaa/fibre-pack
- License: GNU General Public License v3.0 (GPL-3.0)

fibre-pack is redistributed here under the terms of the GPL-3.0, the same license as this
repository (see the top-level `LICENSE`). For the authoritative version, documentation, and any
updates, refer to the upstream repository. Any local adaptations are limited to packaging so the
module imports as `phantom_sim.third_party.fibre_pack`.
